name: Statistical Learning
description: Fit models that predict well on data they have not seen.

lessonObjectives.l1-predict-or-explain: Tell a prediction problem from an inference problem.
lessonObjectives.l2-training-error-lies: Watch training error fall while test error rises.
lessonObjectives.l3-bias-variance: Split expected test error into bias, variance and noise.
lessonObjectives.l4-nearest-neighbours: Fit $k$-nearest neighbours and choose $k$ by test error.
lessonObjectives.l5-linear-as-learner: Fit a linear model with scikit-learn and judge it on held-out data.
lessonObjectives.l6-making-features: Build interaction and polynomial features, and see when they overfit.
lessonObjectives.l7-shrinking: Fit ridge regression and choose its penalty.
lessonObjectives.l8-setting-to-zero: Use the lasso to select features.
lessonObjectives.l9-scale-first: Standardise features and see why the penalty needs it.
lessonObjectives.l10-predicting-a-probability: Fit a logistic regression and read its coefficients as odds.
lessonObjectives.l11-the-boundary: Read a classifier’s decision boundary and move its threshold.
lessonObjectives.l12-accuracy-not-enough: Use precision, recall and the ROC curve on unbalanced classes.
lessonObjectives.l13-calibration: Check whether predicted probabilities are calibrated.
lessonObjectives.l14-up-or-down: Fit a classifier for next-day direction and judge it honestly against a coin.
